title: Creating a Colossal Steampunk Biomechanical Boss for My Game Using AI 3D Workflows...
author: David-Darktree-0321
selftext:
I wanted to share my workflow for creating this giant biomechanical boss for my upcoming game project.

To handle the scale and detail of a massive flesh-and-metal creature, I broke the model down into individual components instead of generating it all in a single pass:

* **Concept & Design:** Used Gemini + Nano Banana to generate the initial visual blueprints and design ideas.
* **High-Poly Modeling:** Fed the design concepts directly into **Meshy** to create high-poly 3D models
* **Assembly & Rigging:** Brought the pieces into **Blender** to assemble the boss, adjusted topology/remeshed, and rigged the tentacle components for animation.
* **Texturing & Integration:** Sent the assembled model back to Meshy for texturing, then imported the final asset directly into the game engine.
